meta_title: JDE Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Bolton
meta_description: JDE Plumbing & Heating in Bolton offers emergency repairs, boiler installations and heating maintenance. Gas Safe registered. Same-day service available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Bolton? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes and boiler breakdowns to full system installations and annual maintenance, we handle every plumbing and heating problem.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to complete most jobs same day, even at weekends and late nights.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted, commissioned, and guaranteed. We source reliable units and handle all the paperwork, leaving you with lower bills and peace of mind.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual safety checks keep your boiler running efficiently and protect your warranty. Repairs diagnosed and completed quickly, with honest pricing.

services.title: Heating System Installation
services.desc: Full central heating systems designed and installed to suit your home. We manage the whole project from pipework to radiators and controls.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Maintenance
services.desc: New radiators fitted and balanced for even heat distribution. We also repair leaks, bleed air, and replace valves to restore performance.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Water supply and waste lines installed or relocated for new suites and appliances. We work neatly, minimise mess, and test every connection.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated cowboys ripping off my neighbours. Fair price, proper work.
about_para_1: JDE Plumbing & Heating was founded 18 years ago on a simple principle: treat every customer's home with the same care we'd give our own. Based in Horwich, Bolton, we've built a reputation for honest pricing and fast, professional work across the town and surrounding areas. Every engineer carries the right parts and tools, so most jobs are finished without a second visit.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we show up on time, fix things right, and don't hide behind jargon. We're Gas Safe registered and hold all relevant accreditations. Whether it's a midnight emergency or planned maintenance, you get the same reliable service — no call-out surcharge, no surprises on the invoice.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. The lad who came out was brilliant — diagnosed it in 10 minutes, fixed it in 45, and didn't rip me off. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Emergency callout at 11pm on a Saturday — they still came. Engineer was friendly, got the pipe sorted and made a temporary fix until we could arrange the replacement. Fair price too. Top service.
reviews.author: Linda H.

reviews.text: New boiler install from start to finish. They explained what was happening every step, no hidden charges, and the paperwork was all done. Heating is brilliant now and the bill's come down. Recommend them.
reviews.author: David M.
